_comment: The assistant (MCP) tools: names, descriptions and input schemas. Read by the core (tools/list, input checks) and by the interface (which tools exist). A string "#shared:NAME" stands for the schema under shared.NAME. edits: true means the tool changes the session or writes files, so it needs Allow changes on. timeoutSec is how long the core waits for the editor.

target.description: Which Voice Chain or mixer strip: a track, a clip, a bus or the master.

id.description: The id from get_session. For tracks and buses the exact name also works. Leave out for the master.

slot_id.description: The effect's slot_id from get_chain. Give slot_id or index.

index.description: The effect's place in the chain, 0 first, as get_chain lists it. Give slot_id or index.

tools.name: get_session
tools.title: Get session
tools.description: Reads the open multitrack session: name, file, sample rate, length, whether it has unsaved changes, playhead, time selection, whether it is playing, every track (id, name, volume dB, pan, mute, solo, output, its Voice Chain effects, which automation lanes it has and its clips), bus tracks, the master and markers. Each clip lists its start and end on the timeline, where it starts and ends in its audio file (source_start_seconds, source_end_seconds, file_duration_seconds), gain, mute, lock, color, group, time stretch, fades, which envelopes it has and its effects. All times are in seconds from the session start. Call this first to learn the ids other tools take.

include_clips.description: List each track's clips. Default true. Set false for a shorter answer on big sessions.

tools.name: list_effects
tools.title: List effects
tools.description: Lists the effects that can go in a Voice Chain: the built-in effects (id, name, group, what it does), installed VST3 plug-ins, and the Voice Chain presets (whole chains such as Podcast Voice). Give effect to get that one effect's controls (key, name, unit, min, max, default, step, choices) and its presets; use those keys with add_effect and set_effect_params.

effect.description: An effect id (such as altaudio.limiter) or its exact name, to get its controls and presets.

tools.name: get_chain
tools.title: Get Voice Chain
tools.description: Reads one Voice Chain: whether it is on, its input and output gain, its dry/wet mix, and each effect in order with its slot_id, index, name, whether it is bypassed and every control's current value with its unit.

tools.name: add_effect
tools.title: Add effect
tools.description: Adds an effect to a Voice Chain as one undoable step. Controls left out keep their defaults; values are kept inside each control's range. A chain holds at most 16 effects.

effect.description: Effect id from list_effects (such as altaudio.limiter) or its exact name.

index.description: Where in the chain to put it, 0 first. Default: the end.

params.description: Control values by key, as list_effects gives them. On/off controls take 1 or 0; list controls take the choice's number.

preset.description: Start from this preset of the effect (list_effects with effect lists them). params are applied on top.

tools.name: remove_effect
tools.title: Remove effect
tools.description: Removes one effect from a Voice Chain as one undoable step.

tools.name: set_effect_params
tools.title: Set effect controls
tools.description: Changes one or more controls of an effect in a Voice Chain as one undoable step. Values outside a control's range are brought into range, and the answer says so.

params.description: Control values by key, as get_chain or list_effects gives them.

tools.name: move_effect
tools.title: Move effect
tools.description: Moves an effect to another place in its Voice Chain as one undoable step. Effects run top to bottom, so order matters.

tools.name: set_effect_bypass
tools.title: Bypass effect
tools.description: Bypasses an effect (true: it passes the sound through untouched) or turns it back on (false), as one undoable step. Leave out slot_id and index to bypass or restore the whole Voice Chain.

bypass.description: true bypasses, false turns it on.

tools.name: apply_chain_preset
tools.title: Apply Voice Chain preset
tools.description: Applies a Voice Chain preset by name (built-in or the person's saved ones; list_effects lists them) as one undoable step. A whole-chain preset replaces the chain; a single-effect preset adds its effect to the end.

preset.description: The preset's exact name, such as Podcast Voice.

tools.name: transport
tools.title: Transport
tools.description: Controls playback and the view: play (from the playhead, or from position_seconds), pause (stops where it is), stop (back to where playback started), seek (moves the playhead to position_seconds), set_selection (time selection from start_seconds to end_seconds) or clear_selection. These are not edits, so they are not in the undo history.

tools.name: list_markers
tools.title: List markers
tools.description: Lists the session's markers in time order: id, name, type, start and length in seconds, and notes.

tools.name: add_marker
tools.title: Add marker
tools.description: Adds a marker as one undoable step. A length above 0 makes a range marker. Types: cue (a plain marker), chapter (a podcast chapter), ad_slot, social_clip, cd_track, cart_timer, subclip.

duration_seconds.description: 0 or left out for a point marker.

tools.name: remove_marker
tools.title: Remove marker
tools.description: Removes markers by id (from list_markers) as one undoable step.

tools.name: set_mix
tools.title: Set track mix
tools.description: Sets a track's or bus's volume (dB, -60 to +12), pan (-100 left to 100 right), mute and solo, or the master's volume, as one undoable step. Give only what should change.

tools.name: measure_loudness
tools.title: Measure loudness
tools.description: Measures the mix as an export would render it (every Voice Chain, fader and the master): integrated loudness (LUFS), loudness range (LU), true peak (dBTP) and the loudest short-term and momentary values. Measures the whole session, or start_seconds to end_seconds, or one track's stem. Can take a while on long sessions.

track.description: A track id or exact name to measure only that track.

tools.name: export_mixdown
tools.title: Export mixdown
tools.description: Renders the session to an audio file, as File > Export > Mixdown does. The path must be absolute and end in the format's extension. An existing file is only replaced when overwrite is true. Optionally brings the mix to a loudness target with true peaks kept under a limit. Not an edit of the session, so not in the undo history.

path.description: Absolute path of the new file, such as C:\Users\me\Music\episode.mp3.

format.description: Default: from the path's extension. m4a needs Windows.

bit_depth.description: WAV and FLAC. Default 24 (FLAC 24, WAV 32 is float).

loudness_lufs.description: Bring the mix to this integrated loudness, such as -16 for a stereo podcast.

true_peak_db.description: True peak limit with loudness_lufs. Default -1.

overwrite.description: Replace an existing file. Default false.

tools.name: save_session
tools.title: Save session
tools.description: Saves the session to its file. Give path (absolute, ending in .altaudio) to save to a new file, which is needed when the session has never been saved. Not an edit, so not in the undo history.

path.description: Absolute path ending in .altaudio. Leave out to save to the current file.

tools.name: open_session
tools.title: Open session
tools.description: Opens a saved session (.altaudio) by absolute path. The session in front stays open behind it with its unsaved changes and history, so nothing is lost. Ids from earlier get_session calls no longer apply afterwards.

tools.name: import_audio
tools.title: Import audio
tools.description: Places audio files (absolute paths: WAV, AIFF, MP3, FLAC, M4A, OGG and more) on a track, one after another from position_seconds, as one undoable step. With no track, or new_track true, they go on a new track named after the first file.

track.description: A track id or exact name.

new_track.description: Put them on a new track. Default: true when track is left out.

tools.name: split_clip
tools.title: Split clips
tools.description: Cuts clips in two at given times, as one undoable step, like the Razor tool. Give exactly one of: clip_id (cuts that clip at every time in times_seconds, which must fall inside it), tracks (cuts every clip on those tracks that spans each time) or all_tracks. Nothing is removed: each cut leaves two clips that play exactly as before; envelopes and effects go with each piece, the fade in stays on the first piece and the fade out on the last. Locked clips are not cut. Returns the ids of the pieces; the left piece keeps the original id. To remove a stretch of audio, split at both ends and then delete_clips the piece in between (ripple true closes the gap).

clip_id.description: One clip to cut, from get_session.

tracks.description: Track ids or exact names: every clip on them under each time is cut.

all_tracks.description: true cuts every audio clip under each time on every track.

times_seconds.description: Where to cut, in seconds from the session start (not from the clip start).

tools.name: delete_clips
tools.title: Delete clips
tools.description: Removes clips from their tracks as one undoable step. Only the clips leave the session: the audio files on disk are never deleted or changed, and they stay in the session's Files panel. With ripple true, later clips on the same tracks move left to close the gap each deleted clip leaves (a locked clip in the way stops it).

ripple.description: Close the gaps. Default false (the space stays empty).

tools.name: move_clip
tools.title: Move clip
tools.description: Moves one clip to a new start time and/or onto another audio track, as one undoable step. Its length, audio, envelopes, fades and effects move with it. Only this clip moves, even when it is grouped with others. A clip moved over another lands on top of it. Locked clips do not move.

start_seconds.description: New start, in seconds from the session start. Default: where it is.

track.description: Track id or exact name to move it to. Default: its own track.

tools.name: trim_clip
tools.title: Trim clip
tools.description: Moves a clip's left and/or right edge to a new time, as one undoable step, like dragging the edges. The audio stays where it is in time: a later start hides the beginning, an earlier start shows more of the file. Edges stop at the ends of the audio file and the clip is never shorter than 10 ms; the answer says when an edge stopped short. Envelope points keep their place in time.

start_seconds.description: New left edge, seconds from the session start.

end_seconds.description: New right edge, seconds from the session start.

tools.name: set_clip_gain
tools.title: Set clip gain
tools.description: Sets the gain (a fixed level change for the whole clip, in dB, -96 to +24, 0 is unchanged) and/or mutes or unmutes one or more clips, as one undoable step. A clip's volume envelope, if it has one, works on top of its gain.

tools.name: set_clip_fades
tools.title: Set clip fades
tools.description: Sets a clip's fade in and fade out, as one undoable step. Lengths are in seconds (0 removes the fade); the two fades together never cover more than the clip, so a fade that would overlap the other is shortened and the answer says so. Shapes: linear, cosine (S curve, gentle at both ends), logarithmic (rises fast, then eases), exponential (slow start, fast finish), equal_power (keeps the level steady across a crossfade). Bend, -1 to 1 (0 neutral), reshapes the curve: positive bows it toward full level (louder sooner in a fade in, longer before a fade out drops), negative toward silence. Give only what should change.

tools.name: set_clip_color
tools.title: Set clip color
tools.description: Colors one or more clips in the Editor, as one undoable step. color is a palette color by name (green, blue, purple, orange, yellow, pink) or number (1 to 6, in that order), any color as #rrggbb, or track to go back to the track's color. Color only changes how clips look, never the sound.

tools.name: group_clips
tools.title: Group clips
tools.description: Puts two or more clips (on any tracks) into one new group, as one undoable step, as Clip > Group Clips does. In the Editor, clicking or dragging one clip of a group selects and moves them all. A clip that was in another group leaves it. get_session shows each clip's group id. move_clip and the other assistant tools still work on single clips.

tools.name: ungroup_clips
tools.title: Ungroup clips
tools.description: Takes clips out of their groups, as one undoable step. Other clips of the same group stay grouped with each other.

tools.name: stretch_clip
tools.title: Time stretch clip
tools.description: Changes how long a clip plays without changing which part of its audio file it plays, as one undoable step, like Clip > Time Stretch. The file on disk is never changed. Give length_seconds (the new length) or ratio (new length over the clip's natural, unstretched length: 1.25 plays 25 percent longer and slower, 0.8 shorter and faster; 0.25 to 4). preserve_pitch true (the default, best for speech) keeps the pitch; false plays it like tape at another speed, so the pitch rises when faster and falls when slower. pitch_semitones (-24 to 24, only with preserve_pitch true) shifts the pitch on its own, also at the natural length. remove true goes back to the natural length and pitch. The left edge stays put; fades and the clip's volume and pan envelopes stretch with it. Looping and locked clips cannot be stretched.

tools.name: get_automation
tools.title: Get automation
tools.description: Reads the settings that move over time on a clip, a track or a bus: each lane (volume, pan, or an effect control given by slot_id and control) with its points as time_seconds (from the session start, also for clips) and value (dB for volume, -100 left to 100 right for pan, the control's own unit for effects), plus can_automate: every setting that set_automation can move there, with its range. For tracks and buses also the automation mode (read plays the lanes, off ignores them) and the fader's own volume and pan.

tools.name: set_automation
tools.title: Set automation
tools.description: Makes a setting move over time, as one undoable step, by writing points into its lane. Targets: a clip (its own envelope: volume in dB is added to the clip's gain, 0 dB unchanged and -60 silent; pan places the clip left or right before the track's pan; an effect control of the clip's Voice Chain), a track or a bus (a lane: volume in dB replaces the fader while it plays, pan replaces the pan knob, or an effect control of its Voice Chain). The master has no lanes. parameter is volume, pan or effect; for effect give slot_id (get_chain) and control (the control's key; get_automation lists those that can move). Points: time_seconds from the session start (for a clip they must fall inside it) and value in the setting's own units (volume -60 to 12 dB, pan -100 left to 100 right, an effect control within its min and max; values outside are brought into range and the answer says so). The value moves in a straight line from one point to the next and holds flat before the first point and after the last. For a sudden jump, put two points close together (for example 0.01 s apart). mode replace_range (default) removes the lane's old points from the first new time to the last and puts the new ones in; replace_all replaces the whole lane; add keeps the old points and adds these (a point at the same time is replaced). The lane is switched on so it is heard, and a track or bus that was recording automation goes back to Read; a track's lanes are shown.

slot_id.description: For parameter effect: the effect's slot_id from get_chain.

control.description: For parameter effect: the control's key, such as ceiling or frequency.

tools.name: clear_automation
tools.title: Clear automation
tools.description: Removes automation points from a clip, a track or a bus, as one undoable step: one setting's lane (parameter, with slot_id and control for an effect) or every lane when parameter is left out, over the whole time or only from start_seconds to end_seconds (seconds from the session start, both included). A lane left with no points is removed, and the setting goes back to its fixed value (the fader, the pan knob, the effect's own setting).

tools.name: undo
tools.title: Undo
tools.description: Undoes the most recent step in the session's history, only when it was made by the assistant (its name starts with Assistant:). Steps the person made are never undone by the assistant.

tools.name: redo
tools.title: Redo
tools.description: Redoes the step undo last took back, only when it is an assistant step.

tools.name: get_activity_log
tools.title: Activity log
tools.description: Lists what the assistant has done in the editor since it started, newest last: time, tool, a short summary and whether it worked. The person sees the same list in the editor.
